global_constraints.description: Per-Ta order parameter constraints for NaTaCl6 glass

metadata.notes: v6 constraints for EnvironmentConstrainedOptimizer. Primary motif: TaCl6 octahedra (Ta-Cl cutoff 2.6 Å). q4 target 0.764 = ideal octahedral value. F_IS expected to be highly sensitive to octahedral tilting.
